statusCard.queryNotCompiled: Not compiled yet. The query builds automatically once the card finishes setting up.

statusCard.pausedBudget: Daily token cap reached — auto-updates paused

statusCard.triggerMembership: New issue matches the query · issue leaves the query
statusCard.triggerAnyUpdate: Any update at all (noisy — includes in-progress churn)
statusCard.modeManual: Manual only — updates when I press refresh
statusCard.modeInterval: On a schedule, only if something changed
statusCard.estimateNote: Rough estimate from typical update sizes; actual cost is tracked per update.
statusCard.createDesc: One message sets up the whole card: say what you want to watch and what each update should tell you. The agent builds the query from it and writes every update against it.

observability.title: Agent observability
observability.subtitle: Send Codex, Claude Code and native OpenCode execution data to your observability service.
observability.managePermissionRequired: Manage connections permission is required to configure agent observability.
observability.otlpHint: Use the base URL without /v1/logs or /v1/traces. It must be reachable from each agent environment.
observability.credentialsNote: The agent harness receives these credentials. Use a key limited to telemetry ingestion.
observability.enableExportHint: Applies to executions that start preparation after saving.
observability.captureNote: Native limits apply. Exported records can contain task content, including prompts and tool output. A collector can forward records to multiple services.
observability.conflictMessage: Another administrator changed these settings. Reload the saved settings to continue.
observability.updateFailed: The observability settings could not be updated.

subscription.priceNote: Enter the full amount for one account or seat. Annual prices are divided by 12. Changes apply from now. Ending tracking here does not cancel your provider subscription.
subscription.savePriceFailed: Could not save this price. Check the amount, or reopen the account if another person updated it.
subscription.linkNote: Linking counts these accounts once, combines their Paperclip usage, and keeps the selected account’s price. Only link the same subscription or paid seat.
subscription.linkFailed: Could not link these accounts. Reopen their details and try again.
subscription.monthlyFeesNote: Monthly fees for accounts visible to you
subscription.dialogDesc: Current monthly costs for accounts visible to you. Token totals cover company work in the selected period.
subscription.noneVisible: No subscriptions are visible to you yet. Connect an AI account or run an agent with a connected subscription.
subscription.usageCharges: {{cost}} recorded usage charges in selected period, separate from the subscription fee.
subscription.identityUnconfirmed: Account identity is unconfirmed. Link duplicates if these connections use the same subscription.
subscription.planUnavailable: The provider did not make plan details available. You can enter the price yourself.
subscription.unattributedNote: Some subscription usage has no recorded account. It is included in the subscription token total.
subscription.feesNote: Monthly fees cover the whole account, including use outside Paperclip. They are separate from recorded charges and agent budgets. Currencies are totaled separately.

costQuality.unknownBillingDesc: This run did not identify API or subscription billing. Any recorded charges are included in the inference ledger. For future runs, select an AI connection in the agent’s configuration so Paperclip can identify its billing.
costQuality.missingModelDesc: Token usage was recorded without a model, so Paperclip cannot estimate its cost. Select an explicit model in the agent’s configuration for future runs. Changing settings will not reprice this past run.
costQuality.missingPriceDesc: The provider did not supply a reliable price for this usage. There is no action required for this past entry. New API runs with complete usage and a supported model are estimated automatically.
costQuality.waitingDesc: This run has stopped. Paperclip is waiting for its final usage data and will record it automatically. You do not need to rerun the agent.
costQuality.receiptUnavailableDesc: This run stopped without final usage data. Its cost remains unresolved for budget checks. Paperclip will record a late receipt if one arrives; rerunning the agent will not recover this usage.
costQuality.retryableDesc: Saved usage data is ready to be recorded. Paperclip retries automatically, or you can retry now. This records costs only; it does not rerun the agent.
costQuality.noNewDataToast: No new cost data is available.
costQuality.recordingFailed: Cost recording failed. Try again shortly.
costQuality.loadFailed: Cost details could not be loaded.
costQuality.showingLastLoaded: Showing the last loaded cost details. Updates will resume automatically.
costQuality.noGaps: No cost gaps remain in this period.
costQuality.truncatedNote: Showing the 25 most recent entries in each category. Select a shorter date range to inspect more.

accounting.title: Accounting model
accounting.desc: Paperclip now separates request-level inference usage from account-level finance events. That keeps provider reporting honest when the biller is OpenRouter, Cloudflare, Bedrock, or another intermediary.
accounting.inferenceDesc: Request-scoped usage and billed runs from cost_events.
accounting.financeDesc: Account-level charges that are not one prompt-response pair.
accounting.quotasDesc: Provider or biller windows that can stop traffic in real time.
